exceptions.project_top: A44_A is retained exactly because DESIGN A44_A is defined by the official DEF.
exceptions.core: A44_SAR_ADC_CORE_1000 is retained because the DEF-bound public contract already carries the 1000 um size token.
exceptions.decimal_encoding: P denotes the decimal point in a physical dimension; 399P7 means 399.7 um.
exceptions.secondary_esd: Official io_secondary_5p0 cell names are retained; public filename A44_SECONDARY_ESD_M2.gds identifies its role.

scope.change: Four series secondary ESD cells added at parent A44_A; external ports and CORE retained.

presentation_rule: Public stems preserve frozen GDS cell envelopes. Dated images measure visible physical layers separately and print their actual W/H. Nominal envelope and visible framing must not be conflated.
